instruction.text: Alex has written an algorithm for filling up his water bottle. Does this algorithm work?

feedback.end: These instructions are precise and in the right order, so the algorithm works.

atoms.a: Open the bottle. Turn on the tap. Fill the bottle with water. Close the bottle.

instruction.text: Alex has written an algorithm for getting dressed. Does this algorithm work?

feedback.end: These instructions are not precise at all, so the algorithm does not work.

atoms.a: Put on some clothes. Put on a few socks. Maybe wear a bag. Put on some shoes.

atoms.text: The blue arrows on the map show Alex’s route from home to school.

instruction.text: Alex has written an algorithm for his route to school. Does this algorithm work?

feedback.end: These instructions are not precise or clear, so the algorithm does not work. Alex could end up in the middle of nowhere!

atoms.a: Go forward. Stop for a while. Turn around a few times. Keep going.

instruction.text: Drag all of the precise and clear directions to the group at the bottom.

atoms.text: The blue arrows on the map show Alex’s route from the bookshop to the pond.

instruction.text: Alex has written an algorithm for his route from the bookshop to the pond. Does this algorithm work?

feedback.end: These instructions are precise and clear, but they are in the wrong order, so the algorithm does not work. Alex could get really lost if he follows this algorithm!

atoms.a: Turn right. Walk straight. Walk straight.
